# `bcm54213pe` – BCM54213PE gigabit Ethernet PHY on GENET's MDIO bus

- Bus: `mdio` (MDIO PHY address)
- Base: `0x01`
- Size: `0x20`
- Carried by: [`genet`](genet.md)

Clause-22 registers. Without a cable there is no link partner: `BMSR` loses link and AN-complete and the partner registers read 0. With one, the partner is the reference board's switch port. The auxiliary-control, shadow and expansion spaces behind `0x18` / `0x1C` / `0x15`+`0x17` are indirect and not listed. Registers with no behaviour read back what was last written.

Sources:

- linux (high): `/scb/ethernet@7d580000/mdio@e14/ethernet-phy@1`; `drivers/net/phy/broadcom.c`, `bcm-phy-lib.c`
- standard (high): IEEE 802.3 clause 22.2.4 (registers 0..15)
- measured (high): `SIOCGMIIREG` on `eth0`, Pi 4B rev 1.5 (d03115), Linux up with a 1 Gb/s link

Carried by [`genet`](genet.md):

GENET's UniMAC MDIO controller at `+0xE14` drives the clause-22 frames.

- linux (high): `/scb/ethernet@7d580000/mdio@e14/ethernet-phy@1`
- decompile (high): start4 MDIO `FUN_0ecc3198` / `FUN_0ecc3280` write `UMAC_MDIO_CMD` at `0x7D580E14`

## `BMCR`

Offset `0x000` · access `rw` · 16 bits · reset `0x1140`

Control: AN on, full duplex, 1000 speed select.

| Bits | Field | Access | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| 9 | `ANRESTART` | rw | Restart auto-negotiation; self-clears. |
| 15 | `SOFT_RESET` | rw | Reset to defaults; self-clears. |

Sources:

- measured (high): `BMCR` `0x1140`

`ANRESTART` sources:

- standard (high): IEEE 802.3 22.2.4.1.7

`SOFT_RESET` sources:

- standard (high): IEEE 802.3 22.2.4.1.1

## `BMSR`

Offset `0x001` · access `r` · 16 bits

Status: `0x796d` with a partner, `0x7949` without (no link, no AN complete).

## `SHADOW`

Offset `0x01C` · access `rw` · 16 bits
